insights.summary: Marchex is quoting lower per-rooftop pricing to dealer groups, sometimes with call scoring included.
insights.quote: Diego flagged that Marchex is quoting lower per-rooftop pricing to dealer groups and bundling call scoring into its price, which is now part of the comparison his GM is running.

insights.summary: Finance and procurement push back on paying separately for add-ons (PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes) at renewal.
insights.quote: Brittany said finance and procurement are pushing back on paying separately for add-ons like PreSense, QM seats and AI Voice Agent minutes at renewal, and with a budget freeze next year flat spend is the best case.
